decision.summary: The garden request has been stuck since January because the landlord has not responded. A note says the landlord approved a £500+VAT quote, but later holds contradict it and there are no landlord words on record. I treated it as unapproved, sent the landlord an SMS with a deadline, updated the tenant and put the ticket on hold with a review date.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: It is routine and waiting at the landlord gate. There is no verified landlord decision. The £500+VAT Harbour Compliance quote in the event 009 note is unverified, and the quote document is not in the case. The tenant chased on 13 March.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: An SMS to the landlord (A1) asking for a clear decision by 17 March, plus an email update to the tenant (A2). The ticket is on hold until 17 March (A4).

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. This is a routine chase. If the landlord is still silent after 17 March, escalate to the property manager.

tickets.description:
Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable
